summary: EnrollmentEditAll is a comprehensive page within the HSPnet system designed to manage various aspects of student enrollment. It includes functionalities for different forms and records management, such as preferences, confirmed enrollments, criminal records checks, clinical ID cards, health forms, orientation, and more. The page provides controls for navigation, filtering, and displaying information according to different criteria and user sessions.
purpose: The main purpose of EnrollmentEditAll is to facilitate the management of student enrollment records and related administrative tasks in an educational or training institution setting. It enables users to edit, view, and manage various enrollment-related information and documents.
